task: Add a backend-only 'effort' generation parameter (low|medium|high|xhigh|max) with a per-model ceiling sourced from litellm.model_cost, silent clamping, and forwarding across the LiteLLM, direct Anthropic and Bedrock Claude paths, LLMParams, agents, DTOs and AssistantService (EPMCDME-13335).

key_reasoning.reason: Touches LLMFeatures/LLMModel config, the LiteLLM model mapper and parameter filter, direct Anthropic and Bedrock client construction in dependecies.py, the LLMParams routing dataclass, two agent classes, REST and workflow DTOs, and AssistantService. It also adds a new abstraction (per-model effort ceiling plus clamp helper), and the effort value is threaded through several shared utilities.

No exact precedent: existing LLMFeatures flags are booleans, while effort needs an ordered ceiling. Closest pattern is _filter_litellm_params, which silently coerces temperature. litellm.get_model_info() drops supports_sampling_params and supports_output_config, so the code must read litellm.model_cost directly. Anthropic raises on an unsupported xhigh/max regardless of drop_params, so CodeMie has to clamp before the call. The enterprise (proxy) and direct paths need separate capability stories. The edge-case clamp matrix needs parameterized tests. No security or irreversible-data concerns.

Roughly 11-14 modified source files across configs/, enterprise/litellm/, core/, agents/, rest_api/models/, core/workflow_models/ and service/, plus 1-2 new files (clamp helper, tests) and YAML catalog edits. Spans multiple subsystems.
API DTOs, Service (AssistantService, agents), Infrastructure/config (LLM YAML catalogs, LLMFeatures) and External provider calls (LiteLLM proxy, Anthropic, Bedrock). No DB schema change.
